combined_incident.error_details: Missing <bair> or </bair> root tag uncaught in evaluation harness adapter

summary: All 140 Baseline/E1/E2/E3/E4/E5/E6 screening calls completed and the configuration selection was completed. However, COMBINED scenario 1 consumed 1 live LLM call before the harness crashed while parsing the response because parse_bair(raw_response) was called without catching BairParseError / BairSchemaError. The fix was committed in ee96da6. Rerunning COMBINED scenario 1 would create a second LLM inference for the same scenario. Therefore, to preserve strict one-call-per-scenario reproducibility and avoid mixing results across different harness code states, Attempt 3 is archived byte-for-byte and strictly excluded from official M4.8 final metrics and selection.
